poses.label: Setup
poses.description: Hold the bar at shoulder width with palms facing down.

poses.label: Curl
poses.description: Curl it up with your elbows fixed at your sides.

poses.label: Top
poses.description: Finish near your shoulders, palms still facing down.

review.checked_by: Claude, renderer fixture for straight-bar grips (#262)
checks: Overhand grip at the baseline shoulder width; knuckles face forward at Setup and up at Top.
Both hands stay on their grip points on the bar at every pose and between poses.
limitations: Renderer fixture only. Final poses are authored and reviewed separately.
